gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the LiFePO4 stations in these kits stop taking solar charge at freezing (the ALLPOWERS R3500 manual says 'Charging Temperature: 0°C ~ 40°C (32°F ~ 104°F)'), while BLUETTI's sodium-ion Pioneer Na kits, which ship now, are rated by the maker to charge 'safely at −15°C (5°F)'.
standout_why: I compared against StormWatts (cited in chat 1) and PowerSized's 'Best Solar Generators of 2026' (returned in both chats). StormWatts covers input voltage windows and series versus parallel wiring in depth. That includes the Elite 200 V2 + 2× SP200L, which has to be wired in series because parallel Isc of about 21.6 A is over the 20 A limit. It says nothing about the battery's charging temperature. PowerSized lists 32°F charging floors for the AC180, Apex 300 and Jackery Explorer 2000 v2, and names the Pioneer Na only as 'with a sodium-ion battery', with no cold-charging figure. It covers no ALLPOWERS kit. So the cold-charge cutoff is partly on a rival page in general, but the comparison against the Pioneer Na's 5°F charge rating is new. I could not open the Dealectric pages, theoutageready.com or solargenadvisor.com (TLS certificate error), so they are not checked for this point.
decides: For most shoppers it confirms the pick and does not change it: the battery-size and price leaders under $1,500 (Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W, ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W) win on Wh per dollar. It decides the pick for one segment: a shopper who plans to recharge from the panels during a winter outage or in a cold cabin. At or below 32°F, an LFP station refuses solar charge 'even in full sun' (PowerSized's wording for the AC180). The Pioneer Na + 200 W ($949.05 link price) and Pioneer Na + 2× 200 W ($1,423.10 link price) both ship now and are the only kits in range the maker rates to charge down to 5°F. The trade-off is 900 Wh against 2,073.6 Wh or 3,168 Wh.

Exact wording: 'Cold-Proof Sodium Power: Keeps working in freezing temps, charging safely at −15°C (5°F) and powering down to −25°C (−13°F).' The same text appears on the Pioneer Na+200W and +350W listings. Store prices that day: +2×200W $1,498 (available), +200W $999 (available).
